insert into PBC_DATFILE_DETAIL_RELATION(DETAILID, FILECODE, GENDATE, BUSI_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select DETAILID, FILECODE, GENDATE, BUSI_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME from PBC_DATFILE_DETAIL_RELATION where 1 = 1 and DETAILID = #{detailid,jdbcType=CHAR} and FILECODE = #{filecode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and GENDATE = #{gendate,jdbcType=DATE} and BUSI_ID = #{busiId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT t1.fileid, t1.filepath, t2.detailid, t2.detailcode, t3.filecode, t3.gendate, t3.busi_id as busiId FROM pbc_datfile t1 LEFT JOIN pbc_datfile_detail t2 ON t2.fileid=t1.fileid LEFT JOIN pbc_datfile_detail_relation t3 ON t3.detailid=t2.detailid LEFT JOIN pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub t4 ON t4.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id /*产品基本信息*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_PRD_ACCOUNT_SUB t5 ON t5.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id /*资产池基本信息*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_INIT_PROD_RAISING_SUB t6 ON t6.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id/*产品起始募集信息*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB t7 ON t7.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id/*产品终止信息*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_PRD_ACCOUNT_END_SUB t8 ON t8.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id/*资产池终止登记*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_PROD_RAISING_SUB t9 ON t9.regist_seqno=t3.busi_id/*产品资金募集信息*/ LEFT JOIN PBC_REPORT t10 ON t10.REPORTUUID=t3.busi_id/*资产负债信息*/ WHERE 1=1 AND t1.cdate >= #{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE} - 1 AND t1.status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND t3.detailid IS NOT NULL AND( t4.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t5.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t6.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t7.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t8.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t9.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or t10.send_status = #{sendStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
